He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

people.name: Rebekah
people.line: Wife of Isaac; mother of Jacob and Esau

translations.web: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.
translations.bsb: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and he rushed out to the man at the spring.
translations.kjv: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.
translations.asv: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the fountain.
